terminals.name: worker
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd backend && AGENTFLOW_DATABASE_URL="postgresql+asyncpg://agentflow:agentflow@localhost:5432/agentflow" AGENTFLOW_REDIS_URL="redis://localhost:6379/0" AGENTFLOW_WORKER_MODE=queue uv run python -m app.worker

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: cd backend-java && AGENTFLOW_DATABASE_URL="jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/agentflow?stringtype=unspecified" AGENTFLOW_DATABASE_USERNAME=agentflow AGENTFLOW_DATABASE_PASSWORD=agentflow AGENTFLOW_REDIS_HOST=localhost AGENTFLOW_REDIS_PORT=6379 AGENTFLOW_SERVER_PORT=8000 AGENTFLOW_JPA_DDL=none mvn -q -DskipTests spring-boot:run

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: cd frontend && AGENTFLOW_API_URL=http://localhost:8000 npm run dev
